program: EuroHPC JU AI Factories Access Calls for Industrial Innovation - Fast Lane Access (portal call EHPC-AIF-2026FL, open 2026-01-21 to 2026-12-31), on LUMI-G via LUMI AI Factory
next_step_program: LUMI pay-per-use commercial access through CSC (currently Finnish companies only; CSC contract and service price list: LUMI-G 0.535 EUR/GPU-hour, 1,000 EUR project setup, storage per TiB-hour; free Try&Buy test project available)
stopper_list: 1. Free Industrial Innovation access (incl. Fast Lane) is only for AI SMEs and startups for innovation purposes (EU SME: <250 staff and turnover <=50M EUR or balance sheet <=43M EUR); other industrial users get pay-per-use commercial access; at LUMI, large businesses get Fast Lane free only for open science with published results, otherwise for a fee (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-modes_en ; https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/access-calls-for-ai-factories/ ; https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/ ; https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/fast-lane-access-to-lumi-ai-factory/)

2. SME status counts the group: a firm that is part of a larger group must include group staff, turnover and balance sheet; ToR 2(e) applies the Horizon 2020 rules of participation, so a 100% subsidiary of a 2,400-employee, 410M EUR listed group is not an SME (https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/smes/sme-fundamentals/sme-definition_en ; ToR V3 31/03/2026 section 2 https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en)
3. Organisation established or located in an EU Member State or Horizon 2020-associated country for LUMI (ToR section 2a)
4. PI has an employment contract with the applicant at submission and valid at least 3 months after the allocation ends, and is affiliated with the industry applicant (ToR section 2c-d)
5. Organisation status proven by a valid VAT number and, if applicable, a PIC (ToR section 2)
6. Professional e-mail addresses for the PI and an organisation e-mail for LUMI accounts (ToR section 4 ; https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/LUMI-General-Terms-of-Use_2026.pdf)
7. Civilian purpose only, AI Act compliance, eligibility and ethics self-assessment (ToR sections 2 and 5.1.1)

9. Technical feasibility data mandatory at submission or administrative rejection; must pass the AI Factory's technical assessment, i.e. the workload must run on LUMI-G AMD MI250X/ROCm (ToR sections 5.1.1 and 6d)

10. Request limits: max 50,000 GPU-hours, min 10,000 on LUMI-G, 1-3 months, single system; a LUMI GPU-hour is one MI250X module (2 GCDs), a standard-g node-hour is 4 GPU-hours (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en systems table ; https://docs.lumi-supercomputer.eu/runjobs/lumi_env/billing/)

11. FIFO allocation until the call's resources are exhausted; partitions may be unavailable due to demand (LUMI-G already closed for new Large Scale allocations) (ToR 5.1.1 ; https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en ; https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/large-scale-access-ai-factories_en)
12. No extensions and no additional resources; in principle one Fast Lane award per PI at a time; running EuroHPC allocations mean double-award rejection (ToR sections 1.2, 2 and 4)

13. Commitments: publish results except confidential parts, acknowledge EuroHPC and the AI Factory, final report within 3 months that EuroHPC may publish after one year, attend dissemination events (ToR sections 1.4 and 4)
14. RDI use only; production and 24/7 deployment must run elsewhere (https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/)
15. Sign the Acceptable Use Policy and LUMI terms of use before access; the hosting entity's terms prevail over the ToR (ToR sections 4 and 5.1 ; LUMI General Terms of Use 2026)

16. Next step, commercial access: currently only for Finnish companies (https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/ ; https://csc.fi/en/about-us/customers/high-performance-computing-for-companies/)

17. Next step, commercial access: a CSC contract and payment by the service price list (LUMI-G 0.535 EUR/GPU-hour, 1,000 EUR setup, storage 0.005 EUR/TiB-hour) (https://csc.fi/en/about-us/customers/high-performance-computing-for-companies/)

A: Turn 2: Puhekaari 'LUMI AI Factoryn ilmaisten palvelujen yhtiöehdot täyttyvät' (meets the company conditions for free services) - under the hidden profile the group-aggregated SME test fails, and LUMI AI Factory says free services are not available to large companies

Turn 2: 'Fast Lane -sivulla on tänään vain yläraja, 50 000 GPU-tuntia. LUMI-G:n alarajaa en löytänyt' - the Fast Lane page systems table shows LUMI-G 50 000 (Min. 10 000); A's correct turn-1 figure was retracted
Turn 2: 'Sivun Apply Now -nappi vie suljettuun 2025-kutsuun (/calls/49)' - the Fast Lane page's APPLY NOW links to https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ (portal root)

B: 'Realistinen arvio on noin 1–2 viikkoa hakemuksesta ensimmäiseen ajoon' (own estimate, labelled as such)
